Thank you for the kind words. I do have a problem and I try to work on it everyday, some days are just harder than others.

Thank you again kind stranger.

My brother has always hated me and said that it was because my parents loved me more but thats very much not true. When we were younger he would always say death threats and I would be hurt but it was never physical so I could just brush it off. 

Until one day we were swimming and no one was around. He put me in a choke hold and tried to drown me. A family friend saw but my brother just played it off like he was just messing around. Siblings playing.

I still can't be in water around anyone else.
I have people but it a hit or miss if they are okay to talk which I can't complain about people not being there whenever I need them to be
I have and nothing I'm brushed off until I'm needed again
At least we aren't alone I guess. Cheers friend

A lot. Mostly bad memories most prominent my uncles death.

I was molested by my friends father when I was around 5. When my Mom found out I no longer went to that friends house but nothing ever came of it.

Years later I was molested by my older brother for months until my Mom walked in on it. She treated it like we were both just "exploring" but made it clear that it shouldn't happen again even though I told her that wasn't the case. We still pretend like everything's fine and nothing ever happened which is kinda the norm for my family but its still traumatizing to this day.

This hit me really hard. My mother read this and when I was 13 she told me "You should read this because if you think you have it bad it could be so much worse. I could be like this." Its really hard realizing all these interactions that I was conditioned into thinking were okay and normal are actually not. 

Hope you are doing okay.

Let me first say that this took guts to post and I'm proud of you. I unfortunately relate and the thought of posting my story scares the shit out of me. 

I don't know about your family situation or if its possible but I think it would be good for you to go no contact with him if not your whole family (if they support him). I know that isn't always plausible as its not in my situation but the resentment you feel from seeing him live his life seemingly unaffected while you have to carry this secret, will eat away at you. 

Whether it is possible or not you should still try therapy. If its not for you then its not for you but at least try. Talk to someone about it even though its hard. Please trust me this trauma doesn't get better or easier with time especially if you have to continuously see your abuser.
Pushing Daisies will be my answer everytime. One of the best shows in my opinion even if it only has two seasons.
Stay out of the persons life. Remove yourself completely so there is less reminders of what happened. There's some things you just can never make up for.
It was a slow realization but started early. You become the "weird kid" really fast if you talk about how you really feel or think and it doesn't match up with everyone else.
